about: Ledger of WR story ids: each lane (a lead thread or a long-running member thread) owns blocks of ids, so two lanes never give two stories the same id. A lane takes its next id from its own block; where a lane lists next, that is the next id to use. A smaller block inside a larger one belongs to its own lane. queues.py check fails when a queued story's id is outside its workstream's lanes, or when one id names two stories. Exceptions record past collisions, which keep their ids: never rename a merged story's id.
